crossRefs.note: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them…
As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house…
The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my…
Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil…
The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the…
The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by.…
I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have…
Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.
translations.bsb: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity?
translations.kjv: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake
translations.asv: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood; the battle against the children of iniquity doth not overtake them in Gibeah.
